input_sheets.description: Main transactional data containing vendor invoices to be processed for payment. This sheet is identified by a sheet name starting with 'report' and contains all invoice details including vendor information, amounts, dates, and payment status.

input_sheets.description: Registry of invoices that remain unpaid. Used in conjunction with Previously Uploaded Sheet to identify paid invoices (those in Previously Uploaded but NOT in Unpaid Uploads) which should be excluded from current processing.

identifying_patterns: Subset of invoices from Previously Uploaded Sheet

columns.description: Number of days the invoice has been outstanding/unpaid since the upload date.

transformation_rules.name: Load Primary Invoice Data
transformation_rules.description: Load all vendor invoice records from the source sheet identified by name starting with 'report'
transformation_rules.logic: Read Excel sheet where sheet_name.lower().startswith('report'); preserve all columns and values without modification

transformation_rules.name: Filter Payment Hold Vendors
transformation_rules.description: Remove invoices from vendors listed in the Payment Hold List using case-insensitive vendor name matching
transformation_rules.logic: For each row in Primary Vendor Invoice Data, check if Vendor Name (case-insensitive) exists in Payment Hold List. If match found, exclude from Vendor Payments and include in Payment Holds sheet

transformation_rules.name: Normalize Date Fields
transformation_rules.description: Convert Invoice Date, Due Date, and Approval Date to MM/DD/YY format; forward-date any dates in the past relative to processing date
transformation_rules.logic: For each date field (Invoice Date, Due Date, Approval Date): (1) Parse as datetime; (2) If date.year < current_year OR (date.year == current_year AND date.month < current_month), replace with processing_date; (3) Format as M/D/YY (remove leading zeros)

transformation_rules.name: Standardize Vendor Names
transformation_rules.description: Replace original vendor names with corrected standardized names using the Vendor Name Changes mapping table
transformation_rules.logic: For each row, lookup Vendor Name in Vendor Name Changes mapping. If Original Vendor Name matches, replace with Corrected Vendor Name. Otherwise, keep original value

transformation_rules.name: Remove Previously Paid Invoices
transformation_rules.description: Exclude invoices that have been previously uploaded and are now paid (in Previously Uploaded but not in Unpaid Uploads)
transformation_rules.logic: Calculate paid_invoices = (Previously Uploaded Sheet Invoice Numbers) - (Unpaid Uploads Invoice Numbers). For each row in Primary Vendor Invoice Data, if Invoice Number is in paid_invoices set, exclude from Vendor Payments and include in Previously Uploaded sheet

transformation_rules.name: Generate Bill Payment ID
transformation_rules.description: Assign sequential payment identifiers starting from 1 to each processed invoice record
transformation_rules.logic: After all filtering and transformations, assign Bill Payment ID = row_number (1-indexed) for each remaining record in sequential order

transformation_rules.name: Assign GL Account
transformation_rules.description: Assign constant GL Account code 60000 to all processed payment records
transformation_rules.logic: For all rows in final Vendor Payments output, set GL Account = '60000'

transformation_rules.name: Format Amount Values
transformation_rules.description: Remove .00 decimal suffix from whole number amounts while preserving decimal values
transformation_rules.logic: For each Amount value: convert to float; if value == int(value), output as integer; otherwise output as decimal number

transformation_rules.name: Format Date Output
transformation_rules.description: Remove leading zeros from month and day in date fields for final output
transformation_rules.logic: For each date field in output, split by '/'; convert month and day to int (removes leading zeros); rejoin as M/D/YY format

transformation_rules.name: Pass-Through Non-Transformed Fields
transformation_rules.description: Copy Invoice Number, Category, Description, Status, and Payment Method without transformation
transformation_rules.logic: For fields Invoice Number, Category, Description, Status, Payment Method: copy values directly from source to output without modification

semantic_validations.name: Invoice Number Uniqueness
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Invoice Number values are unique within the Primary Vendor Invoice Data to ensure proper deduplication
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Invoice Number in Primary Vendor Invoice Data, count occurrences. Alert if any Invoice Number appears more than once in source data

semantic_validations.name: Payment Hold List Matching
semantic_validations.description: Validate that vendor names in Payment Hold List match vendors in Primary Vendor Invoice Data (case-insensitive) to ensure holds are applied correctly
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each vendor in Payment Hold List, check if at least one matching vendor exists in Primary Vendor Invoice Data (case-insensitive comparison). Log warnings for hold vendors with no matching invoices

semantic_validations.name: Vendor Name Mapping Completeness
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all vendors requiring standardization have entries in Vendor Name Changes mapping
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Original Vendor Name in Vendor Name Changes, verify that Corrected Vendor Name is non-empty and different from original. Alert if mapping is circular or incomplete

semantic_validations.name: Previously Uploaded Invoice Validity
semantic_validations.description: Validate that invoices marked as previously uploaded exist in the Previously Uploaded Sheet and have corresponding entries in Unpaid Uploads for tracking
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Invoice Number in Unpaid Uploads, verify it exists in Previously Uploaded Sheet. Alert if unpaid invoice has no upload history record

semantic_validations.name: Date Format Consistency
semantic_validations.description: Ensure all date fields (Invoice Date, Due Date, Approval Date) are in valid MM/DD/YY format after normalization
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each date field in output, verify format matches pattern M/D/YY or MM/DD/YY (no leading zeros on month/day). Alert if any date fails to parse or format correctly

semantic_validations.name: Amount Value Validity
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all Amount values are positive numeric values and properly formatted in output
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Amount in output, verify value is numeric and >= 0. Alert if any amount is negative, null, or non-numeric

semantic_validations.name: Bill Payment ID Sequentiality
semantic_validations.description: Validate that Bill Payment IDs are sequential integers starting from 1 with no gaps
semantic_validations.check_logic: For Bill Payment ID column in Vendor Payments output, verify values are 1, 2, 3, ..., N where N = row count. Alert if any ID is missing, duplicated, or out of sequence

semantic_validations.name: GL Account Consistency
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all records in Vendor Payments have GL Account = '60000'
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each row in Vendor Payments output, verify GL Account = '60000'. Alert if any row has different value

semantic_validations.name: Filtering Logic Correctness
semantic_validations.description: Validate that final Vendor Payments output excludes all payment holds and previously paid invoices
semantic_validations.check_logic: Verify that no invoice in Vendor Payments has vendor name matching Payment Hold List (case-insensitive). Verify that no invoice in Vendor Payments has Invoice Number in (Previously Uploaded - Unpaid Uploads)

semantic_validations.name: Output Record Count Accuracy
semantic_validations.description: Validate that output record counts match expected filtering logic: final_count = original_count - holds_removed - paid_removed
semantic_validations.check_logic: Calculate expected_final = original_count - len(Payment Holds output) - len(Previously Uploaded output). Verify actual Vendor Payments row count equals expected_final

semantic_validations.name: Required Field Non-Null Validation
semantic_validations.description: Ensure critical fields (Vendor Name, Invoice Number, Amount) are non-null in final output
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each row in Vendor Payments output, verify Vendor Name is non-empty, Invoice Number is non-empty, and Amount is non-null. Alert if any critical field is missing

semantic_validations.name: Vendor Name Standardization Application
semantic_validations.description: Verify that vendor name standardization was applied correctly and no original unmapped names remain in output
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Vendor Name in Vendor Payments output, check if it appears in Original Vendor Name column of Vendor Name Changes. If found, alert that standardization was not applied
